title: Three Jets will begin training camp on injury list

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Three Jets will begin training camp on injury list
sources.description: Two members of the New York Jets will be on the physically unable to perform (PUP) list, and one will be on the non-football injury (NFI) list as training camp begins per Zack Rosenblatt. As is the case each year, it’s important to know what these lists are and what they are not. Being on […]
